metadata.method: Inspected the exact register requirements and the tracked file inventory at the register-of-record commit. That inventory contains _archive/hl_stage2/HL_Live_Copy_Service_Core.py but no dedicated Testnet execution engine/transport adapter. The only Testnet acceptance artifact B3-TESTNET-ACCEPT.json is a read-only clearinghouseState probe (order_placed=false, state_mutated=false), not an engine request-path test. No captured request/redirect/identity/bounds execution evidence exists for these transport requirements. Per-row evidence entries below bind each distinct requirement to this missing component and identify the precise untested assertion; no shared sweep is claimed as a PASS.
